body.statement: If every covariance and spectral enclosure in \(\mathsf C\) is replaced by its zero-radius population singleton, then \(\mathsf C\) makes exactly the same smallest-label order, environment-labelled graph, and environment-indexed singleton-range decisions as \(\mathsf A\), and its graph output is \(\operatorname{TC}(\mathcal G_{\mathcal E})=I^{-1}\operatorname{TC}(\mathcal G)I\).
body.justification: This is the required standard-case reduction from the sequential certificate to the known exact population recovery map.
body.gap: The source population algorithm uses exact ranks and orthogonality; the new certificate must reduce to those decisions rather than define a different target.
body.consumer: It gives a deterministic oracle test for the certified implementation and isolates statistical errors from population-logic errors.
